title: Inoki establishes New Japan
summary: Antonio Inoki builds his new promotion around proving himself in the ring. Tests against Karl Gotch and Strong Kobayashi establish the founder as the center of New Japan’s competitive identity.

chapters.title: The founder loses the opening main event
chapters.result: Karl Gotch defeats Antonio Inoki at NJPW’s first show.
chapters.context: The veteran technician supplies an immediate standard for Inoki to chase as the new promotion begins.

chapters.title: Inoki answers Gotch
chapters.context: Their return encounter gives the founder a victory and a televised platform for the young company. It does not establish an uninterrupted title lineage with today’s championships.

chapters.title: The Kobayashi challenge
chapters.result: Inoki defeats Strong Kobayashi to retain the NWF world title.
chapters.context: A prominent Japanese challenger tests Inoki’s supremacy in a landmark domestic showdown, broadening the promotion beyond its usual foreign-opponent formula.
